title: ZeroDivisionError while sending a scheduled report (summary.total)
body:
Environment

Running Lattice 3.3.5 on Debian 12 against ap-south-1.

Steps

How to trigger it:
* Start by sending a scheduled report.
* Use values that are fractions of a cent.
* Wait for the failure and read the log.

Expected

As on every earlier run, sending a scheduled report should
just complete.

Actual

When the total rounds to zero the division fails. Values
smaller than a cent get rounded to zero first.

Frequency

It occurs on about half the runs.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:49 in loop
lattice/report/schedule.py:63 in run_due
lattice/report/builder.py:143 in build
lattice/report/summary.py:103 in total
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
